import struct
with open('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# The frame header is msgpack-encoded. Let me parse it correctly.
# Byte 0: 0x9d = fixarray 13
# Byte 1: 0xa8 = str8 len 8, bytes 2-9 = 'b2frame\0'
# Byte 10: 0xd2 = int32, bytes 11-14 = header_len
# Byte 15: 0xcf = uint64, bytes 16-23 = frame_len
# Byte 24: 0xa4 = str8 len 4, bytes 25-28 = version, frame_type, codec, reserved
# Byte 29: 0xd3 = int64, bytes 30-37 = nbytes
# Byte 38: 0xd3 = int64, bytes 39-46 = cbytes
# Byte 47: 0xd2 = int32, bytes 48-51 = typesize
# Byte 52: 0xd2 = int32, bytes 53-56 = blocksize
# Byte 57: 0xd2 = int32, bytes 58-61 = chunksize
# Byte 62: 0xd1 = int16, bytes 63-64 = nthreads_c
# Byte 65: 0xd1 = int16, bytes 66-67 = nthreads_d
# Byte 68: bool
# Byte 69: 0xd8 = uint8, byte 70 = nfilters
# Bytes 71-86: filters + filters_meta

header_len = struct.unpack('>i', data[11:15])[0]
frame_len = struct.unpack('>Q', data[16:24])[0]
nbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[30:38])[0]
cbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[39:47])[0]
typesize = struct.unpack('>i', data[48:52])[0]
blocksize = struct.unpack('>i', data[53:57])[0]
chunksize = struct.unpack('>i', data[58:62])[0]
nthreads_c = struct.unpack('>h', data[63:65])[0]
nthreads_d = struct.unpack('>h', data[66:68])[0]
nfilters = data[70]

print(f'header_len={header_len}, frame_len={frame_len}')
print(f'nbytes={nbytes}, cbytes={cbytes}')
print(f'typesize={typesize}, blocksize={blocksize}, chunksize={chunksize}')
print(f'nthreads_c={nthreads_c}, nthreads_d={nthreads_d}, nfilters={nfilters}')

# The coffsets chunk is at header_len + cbytes
coffsets_pos = header_len + cbytes
print(f'Coffsets at: {coffsets_pos}')
print(f'Coffsets chunk header: {data[coffsets_pos:coffsets_pos+32].hex()}')

# Parse the coffsets chunk header (BLOSC_EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH = 32)
chunk = data[coffsets_pos:coffsets_pos+32]
print(f'Version: {chunk[0]}, VersionLZ: {chunk[1]}, Flags: {hex(chunk[2])}')
print(f'Typesize: {chunk[3]}')
print(f'Nbytes: {struct.unpack(\">i\", chunk[4:8])[0]}')
print(f'Blocksize: {struct.unpack(\">i\", chunk[8:12])[0]}')
print(f'Cbytes: {struct.unpack(\">i\", chunk[12:16])[0]}')
print(f'Blosc2 flags: {hex(chunk[16])}')
print(f'Compcode: {chunk[17]}')
print(f'Clevel: {chunk[18]}')
print(f'Filters: {chunk[19:27].hex()}')
print(f'Filters meta: {chunk[27:31].hex()}')

# The actual offsets data starts after the 32-byte header
# nchunks = nbytes / chunksize (approximately)
# Let's look at the offsets
offsets_data = data[coffsets_pos+32:coffsets_pos+32+64]
print(f'Offsets data (first 64 bytes): {offsets_data.hex()}')
"
